tldr: Venus in Pisces: love is compassionate, imaginative, and spiritually porous.
body: With Venus in Pisces, Venus is exalted, so empathy, romance, artistry, and unconditional tenderness can be strong. You value love that feels soulful and kind.
gift: Compassion, forgiveness, creativity, and the ability to love beyond surface conditions.
challenge: Idealization, blurred boundaries, and rescuing instead of relating.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
